The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 32% of the resulting slash, which pays for adversarial review out of the adversary's own capital. A farm of 251 keys as a result funds the parties working against it, so growing the fleet makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
